srList.sentence: Materials and Methods Animals A total of 32 adult male Sprague-Dawley rats (weighing 320 g, aged 3-4 months) were purchased from Guangdong Medical Laboratory Animal Center, Foshan, China (license No. SYXK (Yue) 2018-0002), and were randomly assigned to one of the following three groups: 1.2-mm SCI (n = 12, defined as mild), 2-mm SCI (n = 12, defined as severe), or sham (laminectomy, n = 8).
